title: Kyiv Under Russian Missile Attack Following Latest Sanctions
summary: At least one person was killed and ten injured as Ukraine’s capital faced the latest in a series of airstrikes from Russia over recent days, local authorities said.

title: Has business tuned out Trump’s temper tantrums?
summary: MONTREAL — Like exhausted parents, Canada’s business community seems to be increasingly tuning out the temper tantrums coming from downstairs.
